title: A Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Pegcetacoplan for the Prevention of Recurrent C3G or Primary IC-MPGN in Kidney Transplant Recipients
official: A 2-year, Single-arm, Multi-center Study to Explore the Efficacy and Safety of Pegcetacoplan in Preventing Disease Recurrence in Adolescent and Adult Kidney Transplant Recipients With C3 Glomerulopathy or Primary Immune-complex Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis
summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of pegcetacoplan for the prevention of recurrent C3G or primary IC-MPGN in kidney transplant recipients
conditions: C3 Glomerulopathy (C3G), Primary Immune-Complex Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis (IC-MPGN)
Recurrent Glomerular Disease After Kidney Transplantation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female patients with a diagnosis of C3 glomerulopathy (C3G) or primary immune-complex membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (IC-MPGN) who are planning to undergo kidney transplantation because of the disease.
* Have a high risk of disease recurrence following kidney transplantation, based on either having a previous kidney allograft loss due to recurrence of C3G or primary IC-MPGN, or assessed as having a high risk by the investigator based on other clinical information.
* Is fully vaccinated and up to date with their vaccinations against Neisseria meningitidis, Streptococcus pneumoniae, and Haemophilus influenzae type B, in accordance with local guidelines, at the time of initiating pegcetacoplan.

Exclusion Criteria:

* A known secondary cause for MPGN, including but not limited to monoclonal gammopathy of clinical significance, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or autoimmune cryoglobulinemia.
* History of invasive meningococcal disease.
* History of malignancy, except for the following: cured basal or squamous cell skin cancer, curatively treated in situ disease, or currently malignancy-free and has been off-treatment for the malignancy for at least 5 years.
* Hypersensitivity to pegcetacoplan or any of its excipients.
* Known or suspected hereditary fructose intolerance.
* Any other medical condition which, in the opinion of the Investigator, makes the participant unsuitable for inclusion.
* Use of a complement inhibitor for the treatment of C3G or primary IC-MPGN within 1 month prior to the scheduled kidney transplantation surgery.
